name: Ascend the Oath / Break the Oath

description.value:
A single permanent fork, chosen once, at the absolute height of your Oath's power.

Ascend the Oath

Your Oath becomes something the setting itself notices. The Answer now triggers for any ally acting as a Ward-analog within a wide radius, not just your named Ward, and while active you project an aura that measurably steadies everyone near you. You remain exactly what you swore to be — just more of it than any oath has managed before.

Break the Oath

On your own terms, at your own chosen moment, you shatter the Oath yourself — becoming Forsworn deliberately rather than by failure. You become something new: the Oathless. Massive, permanent bonuses to attacks and defenses, immunity to fear and compulsion, and total immunity to the Trial track from now on — but no more Conviction, no more Vows, and the institution your Oath once answered to now hunts you for the rest of the campaign, permanently and without appeal.
